title: Capstone: feed
prompt: Home feed for mixed normal users and celebrities. Candidate fans out every post sync to all followers on the request.

choices.label: Hybrid fanout: on-write for normal; on-read for huge celebrity graphs (work-queues help)
choices.consequence: Uses work-queues for async fanout and sharding awareness for celebrity hot keys — avoids write amplification.

choices.label: Keep sync fanout to 50M followers inline
Always fanout-on-read for everyone with no caching story
choices.consequence: Read QPS may melt without a plan.

choices.label: Replace feed with email digests only
choices.consequence: Avoids the problem instead of designing it.
